svg.title: AJ Motors - API Contracts (implemented endpoints and request bodies)

g.text: AJ Motors - API Contracts (implemented endpoints and request bodies)
RESERVED and SOLD are managed by events.
of reserved or sold cars return 409.
Amount/currency come from Products, not the client.
Creation is PENDING; reservation completes asynchronously.
Only PENDING/RESERVING/RESERVED can be manually edited or cancelled.
New payments are REQUESTED; asynchronous claim gives PENDING/REJECTED.
One payment per order; retry returns existing payment.
Terminal results cannot change; same result can be retried.
No Stripe; recording a payment does not transfer money.
Synchronizer sends RabbitMQ events to the owner.
Gateway does not forward these internal endpoints.
Only Product View has MongoDB access.
Login / refresh / SSO / logout use provider endpoints.
Role and ownership enforcement on business APIs remains SEC-01.
JSON request names are camelCase. Public identifiers are canonical UUIDs.
Business routes remain public pending SEC-01; session requires OIDC login.
Optional scalar fields receive implementation defaults when omitted.
